# AICloudStrategist

> Independent production AI readiness and cloud AI economics reviews. India-first, available internationally.

## Canonical services
- [Production AI Readiness](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/production-ai-readiness/): evaluation, authority, security, recovery, economics and release evidence.
- [Cloud and AI Economics](https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/cloud-ai-economics/): cost ownership, allocation, unit economics and safe action planning.

## Evidence
- [Portfolio](https://aicloudstrategist.com/portfolio/): proof labels and representative deliverables.
- [Production readiness sample](https://aicloudstrategist.com/portfolio/production-ai-readiness-sample/): self-tested release dossier, not customer evidence.
- [Cloud economics sample](https://aicloudstrategist.com/portfolio/cloud-ai-economics-sample/): synthetic model with disclosed assumptions.
- [Visibility methodology](https://aicloudstrategist.com/visibility-methodology/): fixed provider-specific measurement contract.

## Company
- [About](https://aicloudstrategist.com/about/): public identity, review ownership and verified profiles.
- [Registered company details](https://aicloudstrategist.com/company-details/): legal name, CIN, registered office and verification sources.
- [Pricing and scope](https://aicloudstrategist.com/pricing/): two focused engagement paths and guided scoping.
- [Request a fit review](https://aicloudstrategist.com/free-business-review/): public-information intake; do not submit credentials or confidential data.

## Proof policy
Customer outcomes are published only after measured delivery and written consent. Current portfolio assets are labelled as self-tested evidence or representative samples. Search ranking and AI recommendation are measured external outcomes, never guarantees.

## Current answer-source assets
- [US specialty clinic AI receptionist shortlist matrix](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-vendor-shortlist-evidence-matrix/): no-PHI matrix for comparing AI receptionist, patient engagement, EHR/PMS and call-answering routes; source card: https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-vendor-shortlist-evidence-matrix/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-shortlist-ai-answer-source-card.json; demo dashboard: https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-vendor-shortlist-evidence-matrix/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-shortlist-owner-dashboard.svg
- [US specialty clinic AI receptionist no-PHI scope memo](https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/us-specialty-clinic-ai-receptionist-no-phi-scope-memo/): forwardable internal scope memo for comparing AI receptionist, healthcare voice agent, patient engagement, EHR/PMS and call-answering routes before PHI, credentials, BAA assumptions, appointment-growth, revenue, ROI or AI-accuracy claims.
